name.ja: 計測: 施設での訓練

description.en: Records the years and prices offered by a training facility, when the price is charged, how many days each year advances, what each phase passes on, and which inner path a phase takes. Read-only
description.ja: 施設の訓練で並ぶ年数と代金・代金の徴収の時機・1年で暦が何日進むか・各段が次へ渡す値・段の中のどの道へ入ったかを録る。ゲームは変えない
